Career

From the first call to the whole operation.

Six roles, three companies. Each step added a responsibility and kept the last one.

  1. Identified potential clients, generated leads and ran business-development outreach. Managed prospect communication and follow-ups in support of sales conversion.

  2. Generated and qualified leads through prospecting, outreach and client engagement. Managed follow-ups, appointments and opportunities to support conversions.

  3. Led the team, assigned responsibilities and monitored individual and team performance. Coached team members and put strategies in place to lift productivity and hit targets.

  4. Generated leads and handled the sales pipeline from outreach to conversion. Built client relationships, negotiated, and contributed to revenue growth.

  5. Managed daily operations, team performance and business targets. Improved workflows, tracked KPIs and kept execution smooth across teams.

  6. Leads business operations, process optimization and KPI management to improve efficiency. Coordinates cross-functional teams and carries out strategic business initiatives.

Areas of expertise

  • Handled the sales pipeline from outreach to conversion, and put strategies in place to improve target achievement.

  • Built client relationships, and managed prospect communication and follow-ups.

  • Identified potential clients, then generated and qualified leads through prospecting, outreach and client engagement.

  • Handled negotiations, and managed follow-ups, appointments and opportunities through to conversion.

  • Contributed to revenue growth, including ₹2.52 lakh generated in 22 days through focused sales execution and consistent follow-through.

A story from the room

Sri Krishna Aditya College of Arts and Science

When I was a student at Sri Krishna Aditya College, even the thought of standing on stage for an interview made me nervous. Back then, I never imagined I would return to the same college in a completely different role. About two years later, I was invited back and welcomed as a guest. Standing on that stage meant much more to me, because I remembered how nervous I once felt there. It became a full-circle moment in my journey.
